description: Mark alerts read once you have dealt with them: pass `ids`, or `through` with the newest alert you saw to mark it and everything older. An alert that came after it stays unread. It never stops the email the person gets about an alert; only reading it in the console does.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

ids.description: The alerts to mark read, 1 to 100 ids. Ids that are not yours, or already read, are left alone. Pass this or through, not both.

through.description: The newest alert you saw. Marks it and every older unread alert read; an alert that came after it stays unread. Pass this or ids, not both.

name: mark_alerts_read
title: Mark alerts read
